candidate_diagrams.claim: For f:X→S and g:Y→S, the fibre product P has projections p:P→X and q:P→Y with fp=gq; every compatible pair T→X,T→Y factors uniquely through P, naturally in T.
candidate_diagrams.why_warranted: The defining condition is precisely a commutative square plus a unique map from every test scheme; the square makes the direction of all four structural maps and the compatibility equation immediately legible.
candidate_diagrams.specific_content: Draw P=X×_S Y at upper left, X and Y below with p and q, and S at bottom with f:X→S and g:Y→S; mark fp=gq. Beside it show a test scheme T with compatible a:T→X,b:T→Y and the unique h:T→P, with ph=a and qh=b.

candidate_diagrams.claim: The pair and triple overlaps X_ij and X_ijk carry projection maps; isomorphisms φ_ij between pullbacks of V_i satisfy the cocycle equation on triple overlaps, and effectiveness means these data arise from one V over X.
candidate_diagrams.why_warranted: The condition is a composition equality among three pullbacks over X_ijk, where indexed projections and direction of φ_ij are central to parsing; the definition also distinguishes local data from its effective global object.
candidate_diagrams.specific_content: Use a three-index Čech nerve fragment: X_i,X_j,X_k over X; pairwise overlaps X_ij,X_ik,X_jk and triple overlap X_ijk with labeled projections. Show the pulled-back arrows pr_12*φ_ij, pr_23*φ_jk and their composite equal pr_13*φ_ik. A separate dashed/globalization arrow may indicate V×_X X_i≅V_i only when the datum is effective.

candidate_diagrams.claim: The blowup of a smooth surface at a rational point is locally the incidence subscheme V(xv−yu) in U×P¹, covered by two charts with coordinates T=v/u and U₁=u/v, relation TU₁=1; the exceptional curve is P¹.
candidate_diagrams.why_warranted: The theorem coordinates an incidence equation, two affine charts, the exceptional P¹, and reciprocal transition; one local picture can prevent confusion between the two ratios and chart equations.
candidate_diagrams.specific_content: Draw the blowdown π:Bl_pS→S and exceptional E≅P¹ over p; locally embed the blowup as {(q,(u:v)):x(q)v=y(q)u}⊂U×P¹. Label D_+(u) by T=v/u and xT=y, D_+(v) by U₁=u/v and yU₁=x, and their overlap TU₁=1. Avoid presenting one affine plane chart as the whole blowup.

candidate_diagrams.claim: Generating sections s_0,…,s_n determine a morphism φ:X→P^n_S by local ratios s_j/s_i on the cover X_{s_i}; chart transitions identify these local maps, and φ*O(1)≅L.
candidate_diagrams.why_warranted: The construction depends on matching the open cover X_{s_i}, local affine charts U_i, ratio coordinates, and transition maps; a diagram can expose the local-to-global compatibility.
candidate_diagrams.specific_content: Show X covered by X_{s_i}, maps φ_i:X_{s_i}→U_i⊂P^n_S with coordinates x_j^(i)∘φ_i=s_j/s_i, and overlap arrows governed by x_ℓ^(j)=x_ℓ^(i)/x_j^(i). Include the global map φ and the compatible line-bundle identification φ*O(1)≅L; do not imply φ is an immersion.
